notes: the first branch («ح» follows «حدثني أبو كثير») ends at أبو كثير, the second repeats its names and reaches the Companion «سمعت أبا هريرة», so the tails are not shared and each group is written in full; «قال سويد في هاتين الشجرتين» is a variant note by Suwayd, not a link; the Prophet is not a link
